# Octopye Service Context

Octopye Digital Designs is a web design and web engineering business focused on HTML, CSS and JavaScript websites for small businesses. App design is the second core service. SEO, hosting, forms, tracking and care are supporting services that make the website or app work better.

Primary offers:
- Automatic website auditor and instant estimator: checks public websites with rendered Lighthouse-style scans where allowed, detects common HTML, WordPress, React/SPA, ecommerce and builder signals, and falls back to a manual estimate when scanners are blocked.
- Free website conversion audit: review of messaging, page structure, SEO basics, calls to action, and lead capture.
- Form or tracking fix: from GBP 99. Suited to websites with weak lead capture, broken forms, or no useful conversion tracking.
- HTML/CSS/JS landing page design: from GBP 249 setup, with optional GBP 49/month support. Suited to businesses that need one focused page for one offer or organic search intent.
- Static small business website: from GBP 599 setup, with optional GBP 79/month support. Suited to businesses that need a 5-page website, service pages, SEO foundations, analytics, and a clearer enquiry path.
- App design prototype: from GBP 799. Suited to businesses that need app screens, user flows, clickable prototype direction, and app build scoping.
- Website redesign sprint: from GBP 399. Suited to existing sites that look acceptable but fail to convert.
- SEO Growth Plan: from GBP 149/month. Suited to businesses that already have a useful website and need organic search visibility and monthly improvement.
- SEO content pages: from GBP 149 each. Suited to building out pages for buyer-intent service searches.
